constraints.meaning: At least one number, at most 10,000.
constraints.impact: O(n²) brute force is about 10⁸ iterations: slow and risky. Two passes, O(n), are expected.

constraints.meaning: Values can be negative, zero or positive.
constraints.impact: Any sum is at most 10⁴ · 1000 = 10⁷ in absolute value, so int is enough. Because of negative values, left and right are not always growing: check every index, do not stop early.

constraints.text: edges: the missing side has sum 0 (statement)
constraints.meaning: At index 0 the left sum is 0; at the last index the right sum is 0.
constraints.impact: Start with left = 0. The formula right = total − left − nums[i] gives 0 at the last index by itself, so no special case is needed.

bruteForce.summary: for every index i, add up the numbers to its left and then the numbers to its right, and compare. That is n iterations for each i: O(n²) time. It adds the same numbers again for every i.
